outputs.explanation: The lower graph in panel A is a bar chart (mean ± SD) showing HMGB1 signal intensity across nuclear/cytoplasmic compartments and genotypes, but no individual data points are overlaid on the bars.

The lower graph in panel B is a bar chart (mean ± SD) of % aggregate-positive Purkinje cells across genotypes; only bars with error bars are shown, no individual data points from the four mice per group are displayed.
Panel C is a western blot image with no accompanying quantification plot, so the individual-data-points check does not apply.
Panel D is a line plot (time on rotarod across weeks) with mean ± SD; line plots are exempt from the individual data points requirement.
Panel E shows line plots (time on rotarod across days at different ages) with mean ± SD; line plots are exempt from the individual data points requirement.
Panel F is a Kaplan-Meier survival curve (line plot); this plot type is exempt from requiring individual data points.
Panel G consists solely of histological micrographs (Calbindin/DAPI staining) with no plotted quantification, so the check does not apply.
Panel H contains two bar charts (mean ± SD) quantifying molecular layer thickness and Purkinje cell number across nine mice per group, but no individual data points are shown for these measurements.
